units.source_text: 我粗粗地指拭打扫过后，小心地走过有许多处被濡湿的走廊，以免濡湿了脚丫。

en.t: After roughly wiping and cleaning with my fingers, I carefully walked down the corridor, which was wet in many places, so as not to get my toes wet.

units.source_text: 大书院老师房子的拉门仍然紧闭着。

en.t: The sliding doors of the master's room in the Great Study were still tightly shut.

units.source_text: 清晨来得早，拉门的白色显得格外的光亮。

en.t: Morning had come early, and the white of the sliding doors looked especially bright.
